note: Art direction for Aluxes (AL1), since 2026-09-27: an ancient Maya wall painting, after the owner's references (Maya murals: flat mineral colours on weathered lime plaster, bold red-brown outlines, figures in profile). It replaced the first look, carved jade figures in a misty jungle, which read like a video game. The references show Maya nobles; only their style is used. Drawn with tools/generate_art.py --reference <the owner's mural image>.
style: A painting for a collectible card game that looks like a photograph of a real ancient Maya wall painting, in exactly the art style of the reference image and of the murals of Calakmul, Bonampak and San Bartolo. Bold, confident brush outlines in dark red-brown and black; flat fills of mineral pigment: dominant red-orange and terracotta, ochre yellow, cream, soft black, and small touches of Maya blue and jade green. Textiles and surfaces are decorated the Maya way, with rows of black dots, U-shaped marks, stripes and fringed hems. Figures are drawn as the Maya drew people: in profile, with the typical Maya face (sloping forehead, long nose, almond eye), elegant expressive hands, flat, with no modern perspective, no shading, no 3D, no cartoon style and NOT a modern children's-book illustration. The wall is old: pale lime plaster with a rough chalky texture, faded and flaking paint, a few small white patches where the plaster has fallen away, stains and hairline cracks, so the scene feels a thousand years old. IMPORTANT: the reference shows ancient Maya nobles at a feast. Use ONLY its art style, texture and palette. Do NOT copy its figures or scene, and do NOT draw gods, kings, rulers' headdresses, idols or temples. The subject is always an alux: a knee-high spirit of the Maya cornfield, painted in this ancient style as a small, stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals; gentle, a little mischievous, never scary, never a caricature of a real person. One clear main subject, fully in frame. Absolutely no glyphs, hieroglyph blocks, writing, letters, numbers, symbols, logos, borders, card frames or watermarks.

subjects.AL1-H01-kitten: the most endearing alux of all, the smallest, painted in the ancient mural style: a big round head, a sweet smile, a small round straw hat a size too big for him, a white cotton tunic and a sash with one little red bead. Not a god, not a king, no headdress, no crown. He sits in the doorway of his doll-sized house of pale stone with a little palm-thatch roof at the edge of the cornfield, hugging a golden ear of corn almost as big as himself, a small spotted dog curled up beside him. Tender and cosy.
subjects.AL1-H01-bigcat: the most endearing alux of all, the smallest, painted in the ancient mural style: a big round head, a sweet smile, a small round straw hat a size too big for him, a white cotton tunic and a sash with one little red bead. Not a god, not a king, no headdress, no crown. Now he is the proud little caller of the rain: he stands on the thatched roof of his doll-sized stone house with his chest puffed out and both arms raised to the sky, as rain falls in painted lines of Maya blue over the corn, his small spotted dog looking up at him from the doorstep. Proud and funny, still tiny.
subjects.AL1-D04: a small alux in the Maya mural style, a little chubby figure with a round straw hat, a white cotton tunic and a sash: he has only just been shaped from clay by a Maya healer: his body is still plain unpainted terracotta clay with fingerprints, and he sits up for the very first time on a woven palm mat, blinking with wonder; beside him kneels the healer, an old village man in a simple white cotton cloth, gently holding out a small clay bowl of corn kernels to him.
subjects.AL1-D09: a small alux in the Maya mural style, a little chubby figure with a round straw hat, a white cotton tunic and a sash: at night among the tall corn, he puts two fingers to his lips and whistles hard, cheeks puffed out, a small slingshot tucked in his sash, while a startled coati and a raccoon run away through the corn with wide eyes. The night is shown only by a darker plaster wash and a few painted stars. No musical notes.
subjects.AL1-D12: a doll-sized house of stacked pale stone with a tiny palm-thatch roof and a small dark doorway, at the edge of the cornfield, painted in the Maya mural style; on its little doorstep sit a gourd bowl of pale corn drink, a golden ear of corn, a small pot of honey and a stack of tiny tortillas; a tiny alux with a round straw hat peeks shyly out of the doorway, only his face, hat and one hand showing.
subjects.AL1-D01: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): he walks along a row of corn carefully carrying a big gourd bowl of pale corn drink with both hands, a few drops spilling over the rim.
subjects.AL1-D02: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): on night patrol, he marches between the corn rows with a wooden staff over his shoulder and a small clay lamp hanging from it, chest out, very serious. The night is shown only by a darker wash on the plaster and a few painted stars.
subjects.AL1-D03: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): he kneels beside a young corn plant, propping it up with both hands and a little wooden stake, while the corn plant beside him is already twice as tall; a clay water jar stands at his feet.
subjects.AL1-D05: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): he tiptoes away grinning, hugging a farmer's machete, a hoe and a coil of rope that are all much too big for him, glancing back over his shoulder, a palm-thatched hut behind him.
subjects.AL1-D06: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): he stands wide-legged at the edge of the cornfield with a forked-branch slingshot drawn back and loaded with a pebble, one eye closed to aim, his hat pushed back.
subjects.AL1-D07: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): an older, stouter alux with a grey beard sits cross-legged and content on a tumble of fallen stone blocks from an old ruin, overgrown with roots and ferns, arms folded, a small lizard on his knee. The stones are plain, with no carvings or glyphs.
subjects.AL1-D08: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): the largest and oldest of the aluxes sits among the huge buttress roots of a great ceiba tree as if on a throne, calm, mighty and friendly, small clay pots of offerings at his feet.
subjects.AL1-D10: a doll-sized stone house with a palm-thatch roof at the edge of the cornfield, painted in the ancient mural style; on its doorstep a small stack of tortillas, a clay pot dripping golden honey and an ear of corn laid out as an offering, and a tiny hand reaches out of the dark doorway for a tortilla. No full figure.
subjects.AL1-D11: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): inside a palm-thatched Maya kitchen, he stands laughing on a shelf, mid-throw, while clay pots, a round clay griddle and gourd bowls fly through the air around him, a hammock hanging behind. No people.
subjects.AL1-D13: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): he sits on a plain stone at the side of a path through the forest, one small hand held out palm up, hopefully, his hat in the other hand, a little cloth bundle beside him.
subjects.AL1-D14: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): he sits at the edge of a cenote, a round deep pool of Maya-blue water in pale limestone rock with tree roots and vines hanging down into it, dipping his feet in the water, a gourd at his side.
subjects.AL1-D15: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): he stands with his arms crossed, looking up proudly, in front of his little stone house built on a ledge under the huge pillars of a modern road bridge over a lagoon with mangroves; the modern bridge is painted flat in the same ancient mural style.
subjects.AL1-D16: the alux's little dog, painted the way dogs appear on ancient Maya painted vases and murals: a small, slender, short-haired village dog drawn in profile with a bold red-brown outline, cream coat with a few ochre-brown patches, pointed ears, a curled tail and a collar of red beads, trotting happily along the edge of the cornfield, a doll-sized stone house with a thatch roof behind it. Friendly and a little comic, but in the flat ancient style, NOT a cartoon, not a Dalmatian, no tongue hanging out. No alux, only the dog.
subjects.AL1-D17: a toh bird (turquoise-browed motmot), painted in the ancient mural style like the birds of Maya murals: turquoise, green and rust feathers, a long tail ending in two racket-shaped feathers, perched on a root at the mouth of a cenote of Maya-blue water. No alux, only the bird.
subjects.AL1-D18: a doll-sized stone house with a palm-thatch roof among the corn, painted in the ancient mural style; on its doorstep a little clay plate with a slice of watermelon, a small mango and a few sweets, and a tiny alux in a round straw hat and white tunic leaps out of the doorway with joy, arms up.
subjects.AL1-D19: a small alux in the ancient mural style (a stocky, child-sized Maya figure in a round straw hat, a short white cotton tunic with a dotted sash, and sandals): he peeks out from behind a tree at the edge of a forest path, giggling with a hand over his mouth, while the path behind him loops back on itself in a circle among the trees.
